items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Gerry Mulligan was the artistic director for jazz before I was, but he lived on the East Coast.

ctx.x: Let’s take a break here. In 1992 you became artistic director of Jazz at Ravinia and later developed the jazz mentor program. Could you talk about that please?

I was very honored to have the Ravinia people give me a call to be the artistic director for jazz. Ravinia is the summer home of the Chicago Symphony Orchestra. It’s in Highland Park, Illinois, which is about 35 minutes, 40 minutes north of Chicago. It’s at least 65 years old. They’ve always included jazz. Gerry Mulligan was the artistic director for jazz before I was, but he lived on the East Coast. So they asked me if I would be.
